name: BAM-UMoE: Unified Mixture of Experts Attention Block.
description: BAM-UMoE: Unified Mixture of Experts Attention Block.  This module implements a production-hardened Unified Mixture of Experts (UMoE) attention mechanism supporting multi-architecture deployments: DistilBERT, RoBERTa/BERT, GPT-2, and Qwen/LLaMA/Mistral (GQA + partial RoPE).  Key architectural features: 1. Robust Weight Extraction across fused Conv1D (GPT-2), nested self-attention (RoBERTa/BERT),

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
